items.reason: A low-strength 2.5% rinse-off wash that suits an oily, blemish-prone look and is the gentlest benzoyl peroxide option.
A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer to keep the skin comfortable and hydrated, since the moisture score is on the lower side.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, rinse well, and follow with the moisturizer morning and night. While you are trying for a baby, it is best to skip retinoid serums, adapalene and strong acid peels, and to check your full routine with your doctor or midwife.
